title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Acts 11: Peter explains his vision in Jerusalem, and the word spreads to Antioch.

questions.text: What news reached the apostles and the brothers in Judea?
questions.explanation: Acts 11:1 says they heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

answers.text: That the Gentiles had also received the word of God
That Herod had killed James with the sword
That a great famine had already begun
That Barnabas had gone to Tarsus

questions.text: What did those of the circumcision accuse Peter of when he came up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They contended with him, saying that he went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them.

answers.text: Baptizing in water instead of in the Holy Spirit
Going in to uncircumcised men and eating with them
Taking money from the Gentiles
Leaving Jerusalem without being sent

questions.text: Where was Peter when he saw the vision he described?
questions.explanation: Peter said he was in the city of Joppa praying when he saw the vision in a trance.

answers.text: In Caesarea, at a soldier's house
In Jerusalem, in the temple
In the city of Joppa, praying
In Antioch, teaching the assembly

questions.text: What did the voice from heaven answer Peter the second time?
questions.explanation: The voice said that what God has cleansed, Peter should not call unclean.

answers.text: Your prayer has been heard in heaven
Do not eat, for you are unclean
Rise and go to Caesarea alone
What God has cleansed, don't you call unclean

questions.text: How many times, according to Peter, was the vision repeated?
questions.explanation: Peter said this was done three times, and then all were drawn up again into heaven.

answers.text: Twice
Three times
Seven times
Once only

questions.text: In which city were the disciples first called Christians?
questions.explanation: Acts 11:26 says the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch, where Barnabas and Saul taught for a whole year.

answers.text: Jerusalem
Joppa
Caesarea
Antioch

questions.text: What did the listeners in Jerusalem say when they had heard these things?
questions.explanation: They held their peace and glorified God, saying that God had also granted the Gentiles repentance to life.

answers.text: That Peter should go back to Joppa at once
That the Gentiles must still be circumcised
That God had also granted the Gentiles repentance to life
That they would send Peter to Caesarea again

questions.text: To whom did the men of Cyprus and Cyrene preach the Lord Jesus when they came to Antioch?
questions.explanation: Acts 11:20 says they spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

answers.text: To the Hellenists
To the elders in Judea
To the rulers of the synagogue in Jerusalem
To the soldiers of Caesarea

questions.text: Whom did the assembly in Jerusalem send out to go as far as Antioch?
questions.explanation: When the report about Antioch reached Jerusalem, the assembly sent out Barnabas.

answers.text: Peter
Agabus
Barnabas
Saul

questions.text: What did Agabus indicate by the Spirit?
questions.explanation: Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world.

answers.text: That there would be a great famine all over the world
That Peter would be delivered from prison
That Saul would be sent to the Gentiles
That Jerusalem would be shaken by an earthquake
